snippet.title: JUJUTSU KAISEN RUMBLE: SURVIVATON 2nd Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming in 2027 
Wishlist now: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4753290/_RUMBLE_SURVIVATON

Survive, Exorcise, Change the game
JUJUTSU KAISEN RUMBLE: SURVIVATON is a survivors royale where you battle cursed spirits and rivals, growing stronger throughout the match. Outscore your rivals and fight to be the last player standing victorious.

▶︎ Follow us on X for the latest updates:
https://x.com/JJKRS_EN

▶︎JUJUTSU KAISEN RUMBLE: SURVIVATON Official Website
https://jjkrsurvivaton.shueisha-games.com/

Genre: Survivors Royale 
Platforms: Steam® / Nintendo Switch™2 / PlayStation🄬5 / Xbox Series X|S
Release Date: Coming 2027
Player: 1-8 Players
